newsitem.title: USA: Elcor sees '98 gains coming mostly in Q1, Q4.
newsitem.headline: Elcor sees '98 gains coming mostly in Q1, Q4.

text.p: Elcor Corp said Tuesday it expects fiscal year earnings gains in 1998 to come mostly in its seasonally stronger first and fourth quarters.

The company said growing demand for its patented enhanced high definition and raised profile prestique premium laminated fiberglass asphalt shingles, and for its industrial products, should "substantially" boost fiscal 1998 sales and earnings.
In a written statement, the company said it plans to grow with its markets and price its products at a premium, consistent with the "superior" value its products provide versus the competition.
The company said investments to expand capacity and to develop new products and services in high growth niche markets should drive strong growth in sales and earnings over the next several years.
The company reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.48 compared to $0.25 per share for the same period a year ago.

The company said its higher results benefited from record fourth quarter shipments of Elk prestique premium laminated fiberglass asphalt shingles and accessory products, and its industrial products segment's strong turnaround performance.
